title: Pan-Seared Fish with Stew Crostini
description: A keto-friendly dish featuring pan-seared fish and stew crostini. Perfect for a quick lunch or dinner option.
instructions: Preheat a skillet over medium-high heat.
Season the fish fillets with peppered salt.
Add a small amount of oil to the skillet and sear the fish for 3-4 minutes on each side, until cooked through.
Meanwhile, toast some bread and top it with the Croatian stew.
Slice the yellow pepper into thin strips and set aside.
Once the fish is cooked, place it on a plate and top with sliced yellow pepper and a sprinkle of parsley.
Serve the fish with a side of stew crostini.
